The snippet snippets/font-stylesheet.liquid loads the theme's font stylesheets and prints a short typography summary. It receives the top-level variables family_count (integer), weight_count (integer) and sample_text (string). The counts are passed to pluralized translation keys (keys with one/other forms) through the count parameter of the t filter.

Theme Check currently reports three reference errors. Fix only these literal operands so each points to something that exists in the theme:
1. The first stylesheet must be the existing asset assets/font-faces.css.
2. The family count paragraph must use the existing pluralized key general.fonts.families_count (still passing count: family_count).
3. The preview must render the existing snippet snippets/font-preview.liquid (still passing sample: sample_text).

Keep everything else unchanged: the second stylesheet base-typography.css, the keys general.fonts.heading and general.fonts.weights_count (with count: weight_count), and the markup structure. After the fix Theme Check must report no missing asset, missing translation key or missing snippet errors. Change only snippets/font-stylesheet.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
